hook: 2.5–1.5 in the final round gave Uzbekistan the Chess Olympiad on home soil
text: 2.5–1.5 in the final round gave Uzbekistan the Chess Olympiad on home soil. The win over Ukraine in Samarkand is Uzbekistan's second Olympiad title after Chennai 2022. India took silver after a 2–2 draw with Hungary, and Germany took bronze by beating the Netherlands 2.5–1.5. Why the scoreline matters: a team match has four boards. One win and three draws is enough to take the match, so teams guard three boards and press on the fourth. Source: FIDE.
